title: Novel thiosemicarbazone UV-vis chemosensor for dual pH-orthogonal detection of Fe3+ and Ag+
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3850-3867
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07794J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sherin A. M. Ali, Mostafa E. Salem, Ahmed Z. Ibrahim, Mostafa A. A. Mahmoud, Mohamed Abdel-Megid, Belal H. M. Hussein
S3, a thiosemicarbazone ligand, functions as a pH-orthogonal UV-Vis chemosensor for Fe3+ and Ag+. Dual blue/yellow responses at pH 10 and 4 give sub-ppm detection in aqueous media with high sensitivity.
